title: Exploring the Cowichan Valley Vineyards and Winetasting Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the Best of Victoria & Cowichan Valley – A Full-Day Adventure!
Discover the charm, culture, and flavors of Vancouver Island on this unforgettable 8–10 hour tour. Begin your journey at Fisherman’s Wharf Park, where colorful floating homes and playful seals welcome you. Marvel at the majestic Legislative Assembly and snap photos of the elegant Fairmont Empress Hotel. Wander through Canada’s oldest Chinatown and the charming Fan Tan Alley, filled with history and boutique shops.
Enjoy breathtaking views from the Malahat SkyWalk (admission included) before indulging in wine and cider tastings at Deep Cove Winery, Merridale Cider, Cherry Point Estate Wines, and Unsworth Vineyards. Capture stunning moments at Craigdarroch Castle, Clover Point Park, and the Breakwater Lighthouse, with scenic drives and photo stops throughout.
 A perfect blend of sightseeing, history, and local flavors — book now and experience the true spirit of Vancouver Island!
